title: NetPrints settings (schema v1)
description: The user settings file of the NetPrints editor; sections and keys this version does not know are preserved

extensionPaths.description: Folders searched for extensions. Each subfolder that holds a manifest is loaded at the next start

trustedProjects.description: Project files whose extensions you allowed to load

enableAnimations.description: Turns the interface animations on. Turn them off to reduce motion

language.description: The interface language as a culture name such as es-MX. Empty uses the system language

stopTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a stopped program has to exit before its process tree is killed

linuxTerminal.description: Linux only: the terminal command that hosts a run in an external terminal. Empty detects one

theme.description: The theme variant the editor starts in

darkPreset.description: The id of the preset the Dark variant uses

lightPreset.description: The id of the preset the Light variant uses
